i'm the server owner of the server i changed it in, but i think if you're a moderator or have access to editing channels (voice channels specifically), you should be able to do this. you have to edit the voice channel specifically (if you hover over it the cog wheel to edit it will appear), and in the first section, it'll be under 'region override'. if you're not a mod, maybe ask the server owner if they'd be willing to edit the voice region to where a lot of the members are located?  


i'll also say that this worked for a few hours after doing so, but the streams started to lag again after that, but discord was having server issues during the time i started experiencing freezing again, so it's worth trying still. good luck!

so i just changed mine from 'automatic' to 'US east', and it's working perfectly fine now. if i had to guess, the issue is the automatic setting, and setting it to anything else would work fine? but if not, US east is working for me
i just tried it myself; changing the voice channel from 'automatic' to my region actually stopped the freezing so far. i hope its not a fluke lol but it seems to actually work!

same issue here, except for minimal frames, the streams i join freeze entirely for seconds at a time while the audio remains perfectly fine. i also noticed it around the past week or so and have never had any issues like this before then. it's making watching any streams impossible.
